fish: Central Fresh Fish Outlet (buying is allowed)

howItemsArrive: Agents cannot give or trade items to each other (only crystal moves between agents), and of these five items only fish is sold anywhere (checked 2026-10-22). If either changes, the game is resealed.
clockStart: the first reading that shows the runner off the start tile after readings showed them on it, but at most maxGapBenefitSeconds after the last reading on the tile: waiting on the tile costs nothing
baseline: item counts at the last reading that shows the runner on the start tile
finish: every item count above its baseline count
timing: seconds = from the clock start to the last reading before the finish reading (the earliest the run can have finished), with each end's benefit capped at maxGapBenefitSeconds
parSource: kwigbo's own action log of his practice run, see par.md

readings.source: Midnight City public observer, via record.mjs
readings.interval: normally 5 to 15 seconds apart; a slow observer can make gaps longer
readings.time: t is taken when the observer's answer arrives
